text:
Maya: quick ask — we need a short borrow of 8 A100s in eu-west tonight, run ~00:30-02:00 UTC. Can anyone pull from demo pool or vendor slice? @Sam @Lee
Sam: I can check demo pool inventory in ~10m. which tenant?
Maya: r-internal-canary. low-risk workload, just validating an autoscaler tweak.
Jordan: heads-up: there's a terraform lock for billing cleanup scheduled 23:45-00:15 UTC on demo pools. conflict risk.
Lee: ok. if TF lock lands we can do a soft-claim pattern — no infra change. I can run `rctl claim --slice demo --count 8 --ttl 2h` after lock window.
Maya: we really prefer before 00:30 if possible.. Run is short but we need start time aligned with QA.
Sam: pinged vendor ops for a hot-slice option. will update in 5.
Ops-bot: Reminder — demo-pool maintenance window 23:45 UTC (auto-lock). See https://infra.redwood/ops/windows
Jordan: @Sam also note billing team will reconcile any short borrow; they asked to tag PRs with `billing:demo-borrow`.
Sam: vendor replied — they have 6 A100s available for immediate allocation, 48h for the rest. not enough for 8.
Lee: fallback plan: 2x quantized L40s as filler? perf for canary is okay if p99 latency isn't critical.
Maya: L40s are fine for canary if we pin model to quantized variant. can you confirm model variant exists?
Lee: yes — `open-int8-v2` is baked and validated for this test. routing change is tiny.
Jordan: ops-bot can we bump preemptible budget 10% for tonight as backup?
Ops-bot: Preemptible budget increased by 10% for eu-west from 23:30 UTC to 03:00 UTC. Monitoring enabled.
Sam: opened temporary allocation ticket INF-8421 and reserved the 6 vendor A100s. leaving note: need 2x L40 fill if vendor can't free more.
Maya: thanks. I'll update the canary config and the PR: #3421 adds `allow_soft_claim = true` and a fallback routing policy.
Lee: i created the claim after the lock — `rctl claim` succeeded; I also toggled canary routing to prefer vendor then L40 fill.
Sam: vendor confirmed they will queue a short-term reassign; they expect +2 GPUs in ~90m but not guaranteed.
Maya: OK — if they land we're golden. if not, run with 6 A100 + 2 L40s. schedule looks fine. thanks all :thumbsup:
Jordan: leaving a note for billing: tag INF-8421 and attach canary PR.
Ops-bot: Allocation ticket INF-8421 created; owners: Sam, Lee; status: reserved.
